name.ja: 【仮面ライダーカブト】 Figure-rise 6 仮面ライダーダークカブト
name.en: [Kamen Rider Kabuto] Figure-rise 6 Kamen Rider Dark Kabuto

ja: 6インチサイズのアクションフィギュアプラモデル‘Figure-rise 6’シリーズに、仮面ライダーダークカブトが登場！！
『仮面ライダーカブト』より、ダークカブトを‘Figure-rise 6’シリーズのプラモデルで商品化。
● 特徴的なイエローの目を、内部のゴーグルの模様を活かすイエローのクリア成形パーツで再現！！
● 本体キットは、フレキシブルなアクションが可能。
● マスクドフォーム再現可能。
● ダークカブトゼクターは開閉２種類を再現可能なものが付属。
● ゼクトクナイガン、ゼクトマイザーなど、劇中シーンを再現する武器に加え、
アクションシーンでのディスプレイが可能なエフェクトとディスプレイスタンドが付属。
６インチサイズ組み立て式プラモデル
対象年齢：１５才以上
製品素材：ＰＳ・ＰＥ
・組み立てに接着剤は使用しません

en: Kamen Rider Dark Kabuto is now available in the 6-inch action figure plastic Model ‘Figure-rise 6’ series! !
From ``Kamen Rider Kabuto'', Dark Kabuto is commercialized as a plastic model of the ``Figure-rise 6'' series.
● The characteristic yellow eyes are reproduced with yellow clear molded parts that make use of the internal goggle pattern! !
● The main kit allows for flexible actions.
● Masked form can be reproduced.
● Dark Kabuto Zecter comes with two types of opening and closing.
● In addition to weapons that recreate scenes from the play, such as the Zectkunaigan and Zectomizer,
Comes with effects and a display stand that can be displayed during action scenes.
6 inch size assembly type plastic model
Target age: 15 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is painted. Also, a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
(remarks)
・This product cannot be purchased at stores that carry plastic models.
・This product may be sold at events sponsored by our company or other projects.
・This product may be sold on overseas websites.
・ There is a limited number of this product available for sale at 'Premium Bandai'. Please note that the item may be out of stock.
・Due to the application status and the number of production preparations, the quantity that can be purchased per person is limited for this product.
Thank you for your understanding.
